files.colors.json: color family + both themes + measured contrast pairs
files.typography.json: font family, base size, leading, and the spacing tokens that carry text sizes
files.spacing.json: the 19-step spacing scale plus the fixed layout measures
files.radius.json: declared radii plus radius values written elsewhere
files.shadow.json: the single elevation token and the implicit flat default
files.motion.json: durations and easing, including the snackbar exit constant
files.unmatched.json: target concepts the repo lacks, with consequence for agents

fileSeparation: one file per target token family so --ds-color-*, --ds-font-*, --ds-space-*, --ds-radius-*, --ds-shadow-* and --ds-motion-* each have exactly one crosswalk owner
